name: evolve-trigger
description: Run a harnessadapter evolution session from a Claude Code session, on demand.

adapter.title: Adapter directory
adapter.description: The adapter to evolve. A bundled name such as mwm, or an absolute path.

learning_material.title: LearningMaterial directory
learning_material.description: Recorded episodes, read-only. Must contain README.md.

output.title: Session output directory
output.description: Where evolution sessions are written. Relative paths resolve against the session's working directory.

network.title: Allow tool and command network access in the session
network.description: Model API transport is unaffected either way.
